== Reward ==

<ul><li>  {{:Worn Leather Shoulderpads}}
</li></ul>

== Walkthrough ==

You say, "Hail Urkath Greyface"

Urkath Greyface says, "Errr? What you say to Urrrkath? Ah. Hello to you as well, furrrless type person.  Would you do Urrrkath a [favor]?"

You say, "What favor?"

Urkath Greyface says, "Grrreatful I am that you would think to do this for me.  I am in need of a special leaf, called a [Sylvani Leaf], if you could brrrring it to me I would rrreward you verrrry well."

You say, "What Sylvani Leaf"

Urkath Greyface says, "They say that the leaf only exists in a small forrrrest farrrrr frrrrom ourrrrr island."

Give Urkath Greyface the [[Sylvani Leaf]]

Urkath Greyface says, "Excellent!! I can't believe you found it.  Herrre is the rrrreward I promised you."


<div class='facblock'>
* Your faction standing with [[Kerra Isle]] got better.
</div>

Your reward is the [[Worn Leather Shoulderpads]]. 

You can get a [[Sylvani Leaf]] by killing a brownie named [[Ivie Bramblefoot]] in [[Lesser Faydark]].  He is a level 20 or so druid who occasionally spawns in place of an orc centurion in the south corner of Lfay (he paths into the firepit at #9 on the map).  He drops it every time.



''(Note: As a dark elf necro, I am kos to Urkath.  Handed him the leaf twice, once standing up, and he just ate it.  Then once more FD, and he still ate it; no shoulder pads. My faction is scowls, so need to faction up before doing this quest.)''
